newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DEFENDER CACERES SET TO JOIN VALENCIA FROM BOCA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DEFENDER CACERES SET TO JOIN VALENCIA FROM BOCA.

text.p: Valencia have beaten off challenges from Zaragoza and Atletico Madrid to sign Argentine international defender Fernando Caceres from Boca Juniors.

A source at Valencia said on Thursday that verbal agreement had been reached with both the player and the Argentine club and that Caceres -- who will fill the gap left by injured club captain Francisco Camarasa -- would sign next week.
